text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having faced Silence Suzuka and conquered 
the Tenno Sho (Autumn), Mejiro Bright 
shines like the sun, making the brilliance 
of the Mejiro name known to all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, while commending each other's 
efforts, the two parted ways to walk their 
respective paths.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Bright's battle was far from over. 
She vowed to show the brilliance of the 
Mejiro family once again at the year-end 
Arima Kinen.
